info.title: RegimeCast API
info.description: Explainable crypto risk forecasting. Paper trading only. Not financial advice.

post.description:
Read a typed trade ("long 0.2 btc at 81k, 10x, stop 79k") into fields, ask for what is missing, or refuse
politely if it is not a trade. Never gives advice: every sentence in the answer is fixed text.
Create an account (paper trading only) and log in.

get.description: Hourly candles for the dashboard chart, each coloured by the regime at its close.

The paper-trading risk agent: live hourly decisions with their reasons, the paper equity vs buy-and-hold,
and the development-period backtest its settings were frozen on. Paper trading only; not advice.
Current mark price, funding and open interest from Binance (cached a few seconds).
Volatility forecast over the next 1 or 24 hours (HAR-S on live Binance data until Phase 5).
Probability of a market stress event in the next hour (M10 stress classifier, live data).
Market regime now (calm, active or stressed) from live Binance data (M4 HMM).
Hourly news mood (M3), oldest hour first, ending at the last complete hour.

live.description: The live paper log; null until its first hour is published

target_vol.title: Target Vol
target_vol.description: Annualised volatility each position is sized to

stress_elevated.title: Stress Elevated
stress_elevated.description: P(stress next hour) at which exposure is halved (2 = never)

stress_high.title: Stress High
stress_high.description: P(stress next hour) at which exposure goes to zero (2 = never)

regime_mult.title: Regime Mult
regime_mult.description: Share of the exposure kept when the regime is stressed

band.title: Band
band.description: No-trade band: smaller changes of exposure are skipped

regime.title: Regime
regime.description: Regime known at the candle's close (forward-filtered HMM, no look-ahead)

text.title: Text
text.description: The trade as the user typed it, if any

total.title: Total
total.description: How many checks match the filters (before limit/offset)

exposure.title: Exposure
exposure.description: Position after the decision, share of the coin's third (0..1)

traded.title: Traded
traded.description: Notional bought (+) or sold (-), in account units

exposure.title: Exposure
exposure.description: Average exposure over the three coins (0..1)

hour.title: Hour
hour.description: Hour end the decision is for (positions held until the next hour end)

decided_at.title: Decided At
decided_at.description: When it was written, before the hour played out

name.title: Name
name.description: e.g. 'volatility in the last day', 'day of week'

effect_pct.title: Effect Pct
effect_pct.description: How much it moves the volatility forecast vs a typical hour, in %

exchange_time.title: Exchange Time
exchange_time.description: Binance timestamp of the mark price

stale.title: Stale
stale.description: True if Binance could not be reached and this is an older value

hour_end.title: Hour End
hour_end.description: End of the hour (UTC). A headline at 10:20 counts for 11:00.

count.title: Count
count.description: Crypto headlines about this coin or the whole market

mean_score.title: Mean Score
mean_score.description: Average sentiment, -1 (negative) to +1 (positive); 0 when count is 0

share_negative.title: Share Negative
share_negative.description: Share of headlines labelled negative (0..1); 0 when count is 0

text.title: Text
text.description: The trade as typed, e.g. 'long 0.2 btc at 58k 10x'

history.title: History
history.description: Earlier messages for the same trade (answers to a follow-up question), oldest first

status.title: Status
status.description: ok: ready to confirm; needs_info: ask `message`; refused: not a trade; unsupported: other coin

missing.title: Missing
missing.description: Required fields still missing: asset, side, leverage, size, wallet_usdt

message.title: Message
message.description: Follow-up question or polite refusal, written by code

parser.title: Parser
parser.description: Which parser answered, e.g. 'claude-haiku-5-5, prompt v2' or 'rules'

intent.title: Intent
intent.description: trade: describes a position to check; advice: asks what to trade; off_topic: anything else

asset.title: Asset
asset.description: BTC, ETH or SOL; OTHER for any other coin

entry.title: Entry
entry.description: Entry price in USDT; null if not given or 'at market'

notional_usdt.title: Notional Usdt
notional_usdt.description: Size as the position's dollar value

margin_usdt.title: Margin Usdt
margin_usdt.description: Size as the margin put in

wallet_usdt.title: Wallet Usdt
wallet_usdt.description: Cross margin: the whole wallet balance

ParsedTrade.title: ParsedTrade
ParsedTrade.description: What the user typed, field by field. null = not stated (never guessed).

ProfileIn.title: ProfileIn
ProfileIn.description: Change any of the fields; the ones left out keep their value.

risk_limit.title: Risk Limit
risk_limit.description: Highest chance of liquidation you accept per trade (0.01 = 1%); the risk check's safe leverage and position size use it

drivers.title: Drivers
drivers.description: What moves the volatility forecast (exact SHAP values of HAR-S)

stress_level.title: Stress Level
stress_level.description: Market stress in the next hour: low, elevated or high

stop_inside_liquidation.title: Stop Inside Liquidation
stop_inside_liquidation.description: True if the stop would trigger AFTER liquidation

leverage.title: Leverage
leverage.description: Binance allows up to 150x on BTC and ETH, 100x on SOL, less for big positions

qty.title: Qty
qty.description: Size in coins. Give qty OR margin.

margin.title: Margin
margin.description: Margin in USDT (isolated). Give qty OR margin.

wallet_balance.title: Wallet Balance
wallet_balance.description: Cross margin: whole cross wallet in USDT

risk_limit.title: Risk Limit
risk_limit.description: Max acceptable P(liquidation) for safe leverage
